# Strivers Education

> Prepare Smarter, Score Higher.

Strivers is India's leading competitive examination preparation platform and educational network, offering expert-led courses and structured learning programs for JEE (Main & Advanced), NEET (UG), SSC CGL, Banking, Foundation, and State competitive exams.

## Key Offerings & Programs

- **JEE Main & Advanced**: Complete Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics curriculum with masterclasses, daily problem sets (DPPs), and previous years' question (PYQ) breakdowns.
- **NEET (UG) Medical Entrance**: Comprehensive NCERT-aligned Biology, Chemistry, and Physics coaching with full-length test series.
- **SSC & Banking Exams**: Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, General Awareness, and English comprehension for SSC CGL, CHSL, IBPS PO, and SBI PO.
- **Foundation Courses (Class 9–12)**: Solidifying conceptual fundamentals for school board examinations and early competitive preparation.
- **StriverTech & Striver Academy**: Specialized digital learning tools and dedicated academic mentorship.
